financial_raw_evidence.formula: FY net_income / avg_pair(equity_FY0, equity_FY-1); closing>0, opening>0 if present
FY net_income / avg_pair(assets_FY0, assets_FY-1); denominator>0
FY net_interest_income / avg_pair(assets_FY0, assets_FY-1); denominator>0
ROE FY0..FY-4, min3 available: mu * max(0, 1-population_std/mu) if mu>0 else mu
equity_FY0 / assets_FY0; assets>0
(shares_FY0 / shares_FY-3)^(1/3)-1; positive endpoints, official FY0 share basis
(net_income_FY0-net_income_FY-5)/(equity_FY0-equity_FY-5); delta_equity>0
(revenue_FY0/revenue_FY-3)^(1/3)-1; positive endpoints
(reported_diluted_EPS_FY0/reported_diluted_EPS_FY-3)^(1/3)-1; positive endpoints, official FY0 share basis
((equity_FY0/shares_FY0)/(equity_FY-3/shares_FY-3))^(1/3)-1; positive equity and share endpoints, official FY0 share basis
(net_income_FY0-net_income_FY-3)/(equity_FY0-equity_FY-3); delta_equity>0
count(g>0)/count(g), g=revenue_FY-k/revenue_FY-k-1-1, k=0..4, old>0, min3 available
population_std(g), g=revenue_FY-k/revenue_FY-k-1-1, k=0..4, old>0, min3 available
(TTM_revenue/prior_TTM_revenue-1)-revenue_cagr_3y; prior_TTM>0 and FY CAGR available
